Our Locations

Welcome to Sri Lakshmi Group of Hospitals

Introduction Welcome to the Sri Lakshmi Group of Hospitals, a premier healthcare provider in Bangalore, known for its state-of-the-art facilities and commitment to affordable, accessible world-class care. With a network of specialized branches across the city, we bring cutting-edge medical technology and expert care closer to you.

Highlights

  • State-of-the-art facilities including the latest in robotic and laser surgery technologies.
  • A commitment to affordable healthcare, making high-quality medical services accessible to all.

Our Branches

  • Sri Lakshmi Super Specialty Hospital, Kaggadasapura
  • Sri Lakshmi Global Hospital, Koramangala.
  • Sri Lakshmi Super Specialty Hospital, KR Puram.
  • Sri Lakshmi Mother and Children Hospital, KR Puram.

Opening Hours

Our Branches

Sri Lakshmi Super Specialty Hospital, Kaggadasapura

  • No. 5,6,7, 1st Cross, Kaggadasapura Main Rd, Nagappareddy Layout, C V Raman Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560093
  • 080 4167 6336
  • support@slglobalhospital.com

Sri Lakshmi Global Hospital, Koramangala.

  • 86, Hosur Rd, Zuzuvadi, Madiwala, 1st Stage, BTM Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560068
  • 090083 18003
  • support@slglobalhospital.com

Sri Lakshmi Super Specialty Hospital, KR Puram.

  • 301, 3rd Main Rd, near Indane Gas, V B Layout, Old Extension, Krishnarajapuram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560036
  • 099017 11716
  • support@slglobalhospital.com

Sri Lakshmi Mother and Children Hospital, KR Puram.

  • 849/678, katha, No 145, Old extension, Krishnarajapuram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560036
  • 099008 00533
  • info@portfolio.com

Cashless Treatments at Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital in KR Puram, Bangalore

Welcome to Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital, your trusted partner in health and wellness in Bangalore. We are proud to introduce our comprehensive cashless treatment and insurance facility, making healthcare accessible and hassle-free for everyone. Whether you have private or government insurance, our streamlined process ensures that you receive top-notch medical care without the stress of upfront payments.

Government Insurance and Schemes:

For the first time in Bangalore, Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital offers super speciality services under various government schemes. We are committed to providing quality healthcare to all, and our tie-ups with the following government insurance schemes reflect this dedication:

Advantages :

  • Arogya Sri
  • ABARK (Aarogyasri Bhadratha And Rachabanda Kalyana Lakshmi)
  • ESI (Employees' State Insurance)

And many more…

These collaborations allow patients to receive advanced medical treatments and services without worrying about the financial burden. Our experienced team handles the paperwork and approvals, so you can focus on your recovery.

Private Insurance:

In addition to government schemes, Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital has direct tie-ups with all major private insurance companies and TPAs (Third-Party Administrators). This extensive network simplifies the cashless treatment process, making it easier and more convenient for patients with private insurance. Our affiliations include, but are not limited to:

Advantages :

  • Bajaj Allianz
  • ICICI Lombard
  • Max Bupa Health Insurance
  • HDFC ERGO

And many more…

Our dedicated insurance desk is here to assist you with all your insurance-related queries and ensure a smooth, cashless hospitalization experience.

Laparoscopic & Laser Surgeries

Laparoscopic & Laser Surgeries

Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital is at the forefront of offering advanced Laparoscopic and Laser Surgery services, providing minimally invasive surgical options that offer numerous benefits over traditional open surgeries. These cutting-edge techniques are performed by skilled surgeons using state-of-the-art equipment, ensuring precision, minimal discomfort, and faster recovery for patients.

Laparoscopic procedures require smaller incisions compared to traditional open surgery, which reduces trauma to surrounding tissues, minimizes scarring, and accelerates healing.

Advantages :

  • Comprehensive Pregnancy Monitoring
  • Early Detection and Intervention
  • Personalized Care Plans
  • Educational Resources
  • Qualified Healthcare Professionals
  • Integration of Technology
  • Patient Testimonials and Success Stories
Patients undergoing laparoscopic surgery

often experience shorter hospital stays and quicker recovery times compared to open surgery, allowing them to return to their normal activities sooner.

Our goal is to continually advance our surgical techniques

and expand our capabilities to ensure that our patients receive the highest quality of care with minimal disruption to their daily lives. Through ongoing education, research, and investment in state-of-the-art equipment, we remain dedicated to pushing the boundaries of surgical excellence and improving the lives of those we serve.

Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital features a state-of-the-art 10-bedded Intensive Care Unit (ICU), designed to provide the highest level of care for critically ill patients. Cardiac Cathlab

Cardiac Cathlab

Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital is proud to offer a state-of-the-art Cardiac Catheterization Laboratory (Cath Lab), a cornerstone of our comprehensive cardiovascular care. Our Cath Lab is equipped with cutting-edge technology and staffed by a team of highly skilled cardiologists, nurses, and technicians dedicated to diagnosing and treating a wide range of heart conditions with precision and care

Our Cath Lab is equipped with the latest digital imaging systems that provide high-resolution, real-time images of the heart and blood vessels. This advanced imaging technology enables our cardiologists to accurately diagnose cardiovascular conditions and guide precise treatment procedures.

Advantages :

  • Comprehensive Pregnancy Monitoring
  • Early Detection and Intervention
  • Personalized Care Plans
  • Educational Resources
  • Qualified Healthcare Professionals
  • Integration of Technology
  • Patient Testimonials and Success Stories
The Cath Lab offers a wide range of diagnostic

and interventional procedures, including coronary angiography, angioplasty, stent placement, electrophysiological studies, and ablation therapy. These procedures help in diagnosing blockages, evaluating heart function, and treating arrhythmias and other cardiac conditions.

The procedures performed in our Cath Lab are minimally invasive

involving small incisions and the use of catheters. This approach reduces the risk of complications, minimizes pain and scarring, and promotes faster recovery times for patients.

Our Cath Lab is staffed

by a team of experienced cardiologists, interventional radiologists, cardiac nurses, and technicians who work collaboratively to provide the highest level of care. Their expertise ensures that patients receive accurate diagnoses and effective treatments tailored to their specific needs.

The Cath Lab is an integral part of our emergency cardiac care services

available 24/7 to handle urgent cases such as heart attacks. Our rapid response team is trained to perform life-saving procedures, such as primary angioplasty, to quickly restore blood flow to the heart and minimize damage.

At Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital

our Cardiac Cath Lab represents our unwavering commitment to excellence in cardiovascular care. By integrating advanced technology, skilled professionals, and a patient-focused approach, we strive to deliver the highest standard of cardiac care to our community.

Our Cardiac Cath Lab not only enhances

our ability to diagnose and treat heart conditions effectively but also underscores our dedication to advancing heart health and saving lives. With a focus on continuous improvement and innovation, Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital remains at the forefront of cardiovascular medicine, ensuring that our patients receive the best possible care for their heart health.

Modular OT

Modular OT

Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital features a state-of-the-art Modular Operating Theatre (OT), reflecting our commitment to delivering the highest standards of surgical care. Our Modular OT is designed with advanced technology and infrastructure to ensure a sterile, efficient, and safe environment for performing a wide range of surgical procedures.

The Modular OT is designed to maintain a highly sterile environment, critical for preventing infections during surgical procedures. The theatre is equipped with HEPA (High-Efficiency Particulate Air) filters and laminar airflow systems that control air quality and reduce the risk of airborne contamination.

Advantages :

  • Comprehensive Pregnancy Monitoring
  • Early Detection and Intervention
  • Personalized Care Plans
  • Educational Resources
  • Qualified Healthcare Professionals
  • Integration of Technology
  • Patient Testimonials and Success Stories
Our OT is outfitted

with the latest surgical equipment and technology, including high-definition cameras, advanced imaging systems, and robotic-assisted surgery tools. These technologies enable our surgeons to perform complex and minimally invasive surgeries with precision and accuracy.

The modular design of our OT allows for flexibility and scalability

accommodating various types of surgeries and adapting to future technological advancements. This design also facilitates easy maintenance and quick repairs, minimizing downtime and ensuring continuous availability of the theatre.

The OT is integrated with sophisticated monitoring

and communication systems that enhance the efficiency and safety of surgical procedures. These systems allow for real-time monitoring of patient vitals, seamless communication between surgical teams, and immediate access to patient records and imaging results.

24/7 IPD & OPD

24/7 Inpatient Department (IPD)

Our IPD services provide around-the-clock care for patients requiring hospitalization. The IPD is equipped with advanced medical facilities and comfortable patient rooms, designed to create a healing environment. Our multidisciplinary team of doctors, nurses, and support staff work tirelessly to deliver personalized care and ensure the best possible outcomes for our patients.

We offer specialized inpatient services across various medical disciplines, including cardiology, neurology, orthopaedics, gastroenterology, and more. Our IPD is supported by an in-house critical care unit, intensive care unit (ICU), and high-dependency unit (HDU), equipped with cutting-edge technology to manage severe and life-threatening conditions. Our team follows rigorous protocols and leverages advanced monitoring systems to provide continuous care and swiftly respond to any changes in a patient’s condition.

Advantages :

  • Comprehensive Pregnancy Monitoring
  • Early Detection and Intervention
  • Personalized Care Plans
  • Educational Resources
  • Qualified Healthcare Professionals
  • Integration of Technology
  • Patient Testimonials and Success Stories

24/7 Outpatient Department (OPD)

Our OPD services are designed to offer convenient access to medical consultations, diagnostic services, and treatment procedures without the need for hospitalization. The 24/7 availability of our OPD ensures that patients can seek medical attention at any time, accommodating their schedules and addressing urgent healthcare needs.

Patients can access a wide range of specialist consultations in our OPD, including general medicine, paediatrics, gynecology, dermatology, and more. Our experienced physicians and healthcare professionals are dedicated to delivering high-quality, patient-centered care. The OPD is equipped with modern diagnostic tools and facilities, allowing for prompt and accurate diagnosis and treatment.
Our 24/7 OPD also supports preventive healthcare through routine check-ups, health screenings, and vaccinations, helping patients maintain their health and well-being.

24/7 Laboratory

Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital’s 24/7 Laboratory is a cornerstone of our commitment to providing comprehensive, round-the-clock healthcare services. Our state-of-the-art laboratory operates continuously, ensuring that critical diagnostic services are always available to support timely and accurate patient care.

Staffed by a team of highly trained and experienced laboratory professionals, including pathologists, lab technicians, and support staff, our 24/7 Laboratory is equipped with advanced diagnostic equipment and technologies. This enables us to conduct a wide range of tests, from routine blood work and urinalysis to complex biochemical, microbiological, and histopathological analyses.

Advantages :

  • Comprehensive Pregnancy Monitoring
  • Early Detection and Intervention
  • Personalized Care Plans
  • Educational Resources
  • Qualified Healthcare Professionals
  • Integration of Technology
  • Patient Testimonials and Success Stories
The 24/7 availability of our laboratory

services is particularly crucial in emergency and trauma care situations, where rapid diagnostic results can significantly impact treatment decisions and patient outcomes. Our lab team works in close collaboration with the hospital's emergency department and medical specialists to ensure that urgent test results are delivered promptly, facilitating swift and effective medical interventions.

our 24/7 Laboratory

At Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital, our 24/7 Laboratory ensures that reliable and timely diagnostic services are always within reach, providing essential support to our medical team and peace of mind to our patients. By delivering precise and prompt diagnostic results, we help pave the way for effective treatment and better health outcomes for all.

In addition to immediate medical attention

Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital provides continuous monitoring and post-emergency care to ensure patients' recovery and rehabilitation. Our commitment to excellence in emergency and trauma care ensures that patients receive timely, efficient, and compassionate care during their most critical moments.

Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital’s 24/7 Pharmacy is a vital part of our commitment to providing comprehensive healthcare services. Understanding the critical role that timely medication plays in patient care, our pharmacy operates nonstop to ensure that patients and their families have access to necessary medications at any hour of the day or night.

Our 24/7 Pharmacy is staffed by a team of experienced pharmacists and pharmacy technicians who are dedicated to delivering accurate, efficient, and compassionate service. These professionals are available to provide expert advice on medication usage, potential side effects, and drug interactions, ensuring that patients fully understand their prescriptions and how to take them safely.

Advantages :

  • Comprehensive Pregnancy Monitoring
  • Early Detection and Intervention
  • Personalized Care Plans
  • Educational Resources
  • Qualified Healthcare Professionals
  • Integration of Technology
  • Patient Testimonials and Success Stories
Equipped with a wide range of medications

including emergency drugs, antibiotics, chronic disease medications, and specialized treatments, our pharmacy ensures that all patient needs are met promptly. Whether it’s a sudden health issue requiring immediate medication or the need to refill a regular prescription, our 24/7 Pharmacy is always prepared.

our 24/7 Pharmacy

At Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital, is more than just a convenience—it is a crucial element of our healthcare services, ensuring that patients receive the medications they need, exactly when they need them, supporting better health outcomes and peace of mind.

Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital is dedicated to providing emergency and trauma care, ensuring that critical medical services are available 24/7. Our Emergency and Trauma Care Department is equipped with state-of-the-art medical technology and staffed by a team of highly skilled professionals, including emergency physicians, trauma surgeons, nurses, and support staff, all trained to handle a wide range of medical emergencies and traumatic injuries with precision and compassion.

Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital is dedicated to providing emergency and trauma care, ensuring that critical medical services are available 24/7. Our Emergency and Trauma Care Department is equipped with state-of-the-art medical technology and staffed by a team of highly skilled professionals, including emergency physicians, trauma surgeons, nurses, and support staff, all trained to handle a wide range of medical emergencies and traumatic injuries with precision and compassion.

Advantages :

  • Comprehensive Pregnancy Monitoring
  • Early Detection and Intervention
  • Personalized Care Plans
  • Educational Resources

  • Integration of Technology

Our multidisciplinary approach

to trauma care involves close collaboration between various specialists, including orthopaedic surgeons, neurosurgeons, cardiologists, and anaesthesiologists, to provide comprehensive care for complex injuries. This integrated approach ensures that patients receive the most effective treatment plans tailored to their specific needs.

The hospital's 24/7 emergency services

extend beyond trauma care to include medical emergencies such as heart attacks, strokes, respiratory distress, and severe infections. Our emergency team is trained in advanced life support techniques and follows internationally recognized protocols to deliver the highest standard of care.

In addition to immediate medical attention

Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital provides continuous monitoring and post-emergency care to ensure patients' recovery and rehabilitation. Our commitment to excellence in emergency and trauma care ensures that patients receive timely, efficient, and compassionate care during their most critical moments.

Privacy Policy for Sri Lakshmi Global Hospital

Privacy Policy

Last updated: June 15, 2024

This Privacy Policy describes Our policies and procedures on the collection, use and disclosure of Your information when You use the Service and tells You about Your privacy rights and how the law protects You.

We use Your Personal data to provide and improve the Service. By using the Service, You agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this Privacy

Policy. This Privacy Policy has been created with the help of the Privacy Policy Generator.

 

Interpretation and Definitions

 Interpretation

The words of which the initial letter is capitalized have meanings defined under the following conditions. The following definitions shall have the same meaning regardless of whether they appear in singular or in plural.

Definitions

 For the purposes of this Privacy Policy:

  •  Account means a unique account created for You to access our Service or parts of our Service.
  • Affiliate means an entity that controls, is controlled by or is under common control with a party, where “control” means ownership of 50% or more of the shares, equity interest or other securities entitled to vote for election of directors or other managing authority.
  •  Company (referred to as either “the Company”, “We”, “Us” or “Our” in this Agreement) refers to Sri Lakshmi Global Hospital LLP, 86, Hosur Rd, Zuzuvadi, Madiwala, 1st Stage, BTM Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560068.
  • Cookies are small files that are placed on Your computer, mobile device or any other device by a website, containing the details of Your browsing history on that website among its many uses.
  • Country refers to: Karnataka, India
  • Device means any device that can access the Service such as a computer, a cellphone or a digital tablet.
  • Personal Data is any information that relates to an identified or identifiable individual.
  • Service refers to the Website.
  •  Service Provider means any natural or legal person who processes the data on behalf of the Company. It refers to third-party companies or individuals employed by the Company to facilitate the Service, to provide the Service on behalf of the Company, to perform services related to the Service or to assist the Company in analyzing how the Service is used.
  • Third-party Social Media Service refers to any website or any social network website through which a User can log in or create an account to use the Service.
  • Usage Data refers to data collected automatically, either generated by the use of the Service or from the Service infrastructure itself (for example, the duration of a page visit).
  • Website refers to Sri Lakshmi Global Hospital , accessible from https://srilakshmihospitals.in/
  • You means the individual accessing or using the Service, or the company, or other legal entity on behalf of which such individual is accessing or using the Service, as applicable. 

 

Collecting and Using Your Personal Data

 Types of Data Collected

 Personal Data

 While using Our Service, We may ask You to provide Us with certain personally identifiable information that can be used to contact or identify You. Personally

identifiable information may include, but is not limited to:

  • Email address
  • First name and last name
  • Phone number
  • Address, State, Province, ZIP/Postal code, City
  • Usage Data

 

Usage Data

Usage Data is collected automatically when using the Service.

Usage Data may include information such as Your Device’s Internet Protocol address (e.g. IP address), browser type, browser version, the pages of our Service that You visit, the time and date of Your visit, the time spent on those pages, unique device identifiers and other diagnostic data.

When You access the Service by or through a mobile device, We may collect certain information automatically, including, but not limited to, the type of mobile device Yo

use, Your mobile device unique ID, the IP address of Your mobile device, Your mobile operating system, the type of mobile Internet browser You use, unique device identifiers and other diagnostic data.

 We may also collect information that Your browser sends whenever You visit our Service or when You access the Service by or through a mobile device.

 Information from Third-Party Social Media Services

 The Company allows You to create an account and log in to use the Service through the following Third-party Social Media Services:

  • Google

  • Facebook

  • Instagram

  • Twitter

  • LinkedIn

If You decide to register through or otherwise grant us access to a Third-Party Social Media Service, We may collect Personal data that is already associated with Your Third-Party Social Media Service’s account, such as Your name, Your email address, Your activities or Your contact list associated with that account.

You may also have the option of sharing additional information with the Company through Your Third-Party Social Media Service’s account. If You choose to provide such

information and Personal Data, during registration or otherwise, You are giving the

Company permission to use, share, and store it in a manner consistent with this Privacy Policy.

 

Tracking Technologies and Cookies

We use Cookies and similar tracking technologies to track the activity on Our Service and store certain information. Tracking technologies used are beacons, tags, and scripts to collect and track information and to improve and analyze Our Service. The technologies We use may include:

  • Cookies or Browser Cookies. A cookie is a small file placed on Your Device. You can instruct Your browser to refuse all Cookies or to indicate when a Cookie is being sent. However, if You do not accept Cookies, You may not be able to use some parts of our Service. Unless you have adjusted Your browser setting so that it will refuse Cookies, our Service may use Cookies.

  • Web Beacons. Certain sections of our Service and our emails may contain small electronic files known as web beacons (also referred to as clear gifs, pixel tags, and single-pixel gifs) that permit the Company, for example, to count users who have visited those pages or opened an email and for other related website statistics (for example, recording the popularity of a certain section and verifying system and server integrity).

Cookies can be “Persistent” or “Session” Cookies. Persistent Cookies remain on Your personal computer or mobile device when You go offline, while Session Cookies are deleted as soon as You close Your web browser. You can learn more about cookies on TermsFeed website article.

We use both Session and Persistent Cookies for the purposes set out below:

  •  Necessary / Essential Cookies

Type: Session Cookies Administered by: Us

Purpose: These Cookies are essential to provide You with services available through the Website and to enable You to use some of its features. They help to authenticate users and prevent fraudulent use of user accounts.                 Without these Cookies, the services that You have asked for cannot be provided, and We only use these Cookies to provide You with those services.

  • Cookies Policy / Notice Acceptance Cookies

Type: Persistent Cookies Administered by: Us

Purpose: These Cookies identify if users have accepted the use of cookies on the Website.

  • Functionality Cookies Type: Persistent Cookies Administered by: Us

Purpose: These Cookies allow us to remember choices You make when You use the Website, such as remembering your login details or language preference.

The purpose of these Cookies is to provide You with a more personal experience and to avoid You having to re-enter your preferences every time You use the Website.

For more information about the cookies we use and your choices regarding cookies, please visit our Cookies Policy or the Cookies section of our Privacy Policy.

 

Use of Your Personal Data

 The Company may use Personal Data for the following purposes:

  • To provide and maintain our Service, including to monitor the usage of our Service.
  • To manage Your Account: to manage Your registration as a user of the Service. The Personal Data You provide can give You access to different functionalities of the Service that are available to You as a registered user.
  • For the performance of a contract: the development, compliance and undertaking of the purchase contract for the products, items or services You have purchased or of any other contract with Us through the Service.
  • To contact You: To contact You by email, telephone calls, SMS, or other equivalent forms of electronic communication, such as a mobile application’s push notifications regarding updates or informative communications related to the functionalities, products or contracted services, including the security updates, when necessary or reasonable for their implementation.
  • To provide You with news, special offers and general information about other goods, services and events which we offer that are similar to those that you have already purchased or enquired about unless You have opted not to receive such information.
  • To manage Your requests: To attend and manage Your requests to Us.
  • For business transfers: We may use Your information to evaluate or conduct a merger, divestiture, restructuring, reorganization, dissolution, or other sale or transfer of some or all of Our assets, whether as a going concern or as part of

bankruptcy, liquidation, or similar proceeding, in which Personal Data held by Us about our Service users is among the assets transferred.

  • For other purposes: We may use Your information for other purposes, such as data analysis, identifying usage trends, determining the effectiveness of our promotional campaigns and to evaluate and improve our Service, products, services, marketing and your experience.

We may share Your personal information in the following situations:

  • With Service Providers: We may share Your personal information with Service Providers to monitor and analyze the use of our Service, to contact You.
  • For business transfers: We may share or transfer Your personal information in connection with, or during negotiations of, any merger, sale of Company assets, financing, or acquisition of all or a portion of Our business to another company.
  • With Affiliates: We may share Your information with Our affiliates, in which case we will require those affiliates to honor this Privacy Policy. Affiliates include Our parent company and any other subsidiaries, joint venture partners or other companies that We control or that are under common control with Us.
  • With business partners: We may share Your information with Our business partners to offer You certain products, services or promotions.
  • With other users: when You share personal information or otherwise interact in the public areas with other users, such information may be viewed by all users and may be publicly distributed outside. If You interact with other users or register through a Third-Party Social Media Service, Your contacts on the Third-Party

Social Media Service may see Your name, profile, pictures and description of Your activity. Similarly, other users will be able to view descriptions of Your activity, communicate with You and view Your profile.

  • With Your consent: We may disclose Your personal information for any other purpose with Your consent.

 

Retention of Your Personal Data

The Company will retain Your Personal Data only for as long as is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. We will retain and use Your Personal Data to the extent necessary to comply with our legal obligations (for example, if we are required to retain your data to comply with applicable laws), resolve disputes, and enforce our legal agreements and policies.

The Company will also retain Usage Data for internal analysis purposes. Usage Data is generally retained for a shorter period of time, except when this data is used to

strengthen the security or to improve the functionality of Our Service, or We are legally obligated to retain this data for longer time periods.

 

Transfer of Your Personal Data

Your information, including Personal Data, is processed at the Company’s operating offices and in any other places where the parties involved in the processing are located. It means that this information may be transferred to — and maintained on — computers located outside of Your state, province, country or other governmental jurisdiction where the data protection laws may differ than those from Your jurisdiction.

Your consent to this Privacy Policy followed by Your submission of such information represents Your agreement to that transfer.

The Company will take all steps reasonably necessary to ensure that Your data is treated securely and in accordance with this Privacy Policy and no transfer of Your

Personal Data will take place to an organization or a country unless there are adequate controls in place including the security of Your data and other personal information.

 

Delete Your Personal Data

You have the right to delete or request that We assist in deleting the Personal Data that We have collected about You.

Our Service may give You the ability to delete certain information about You from within the Service.

You may update, amend, or delete Your information at any time by signing in to Your Account, if you have one, and visiting the account settings section that allows you to manage Your personal information. You may also contact Us to request access to, correct, or delete any personal information that You have provided to Us.

 Please note, however, that We may need to retain certain information when we have a legal obligation or lawful basis to do so.

 

Disclosure of Your Personal Data

Business Transactions

If the Company is involved in a merger, acquisition or asset sale, Your Personal Data may be transferred. We will provide notice before Your Personal Data is transferred and becomes subject to a different Privacy Policy.

Law enforcement

Under certain circumstances, the Company may be required to disclose Your Personal Data if required to do so by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities (e.g. a court or a government agency).

 

Other legal requirements

 The Company may disclose Your Personal Data in the good faith belief that such action is necessary to:

  •  Comply with a legal obligation
  • Protect and defend the rights or property of the Company
  • Prevent or investigate possible wrongdoing in connection with the Service
  • Protect the personal safety of Users of the Service or the public
  • Protect against legal liability

 

Security of Your Personal Data

 The security of Your Personal Data is important to Us, but remember that no method of transmission over the Internet, or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While We strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect Your Personal Data, We cannot guarantee its absolute security.

Children’s Privacy

 Our Service does not address anyone under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from anyone under the age of 13. If You are a parent or guardian and You are aware that Your child has provided Us with Personal Data, please contact Us. If We become aware that We have collected Personal Data from anyone under the age of 13 without verification of parental consent, We take steps to remove that information from Our servers.

If We need to rely on consent as a legal basis for processing Your information and Your country requires consent from a parent, We may require Your parent’s consent before We collect and use that information.

Links to Other Websites

 Our Service may contain links to other websites that are not operated by Us. If You click on a third party link, You will be directed to that third party’s site. We strongly advise You to review the Privacy Policy of every site You visit.

 We have no control over and assume no responsibility for the content, privacy policies or practices of any third party sites or services.

 

Changes to this Privacy Policy

 We may update Our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify You of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.

 We will let You know via email and/or a prominent notice on Our Service, prior to the change becoming effective and update the “Last updated” date at the top of this Privacy Policy.

 You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes. Changes to this Privacy Policy are effective when they are posted on this page.

 

Contact Us

 If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, You can contact us:

  • By visiting this page on our website: https://srilakshmihospitals.in/index.php/contact/
  •  By phone number: 900-831-8003

How can we help you?
When should I see a general practitioner?

You should see a general practitioner for routine medical check-ups, preventive care, and the management of non-emergency medical conditions.

How often should I have a medical check-up?

The frequency of medical check-ups may vary based on age, health status, and risk factors. Typically, adults should have a check-up once a year.

What are the risk factors for heart disease?

Risk factors for heart disease include high blood pressure, high cholesterol, smoking, obesity, physical inactivity, and a family history of heart disease.

Can I prevent diabetes?

Type 2 diabetes can often be prevented or delayed through lifestyle changes, such as maintaining a healthy weight, eating a balanced diet, and engaging in regular physical activity.

What should I do if I have symptoms of depression or anxiety?

If you experience symptoms of depression or anxiety, reach out to your general practitioner or a mental health professional for evaluation and appropriate management.

How can I maintain a healthy lifestyle?

A healthy lifestyle involves eating a balanced diet, staying physically active, avoiding smoking and excessive alcohol consumption, managing stress, and getting regular medical check-ups.

Do I need vaccinations as an adult?

Yes, adults may need vaccinations to protect against various infectious diseases. Consult your general practitioner to determine which vaccines are recommended for you.

Can general practitioners treat chronic conditions?

Yes, general practitioners are trained to manage and treat various chronic conditions, such as diabetes, hypertension, and asthma.

How can we help you?
What causes cancer?

Cancer is caused by changes (mutations) in the DNA of cells, leading to uncontrolled cell growth and tumor formation. These mutations can occur due to various factors, including genetic predisposition, exposure to carcinogens, and lifestyle choices.

Is cancer always hereditary?

No, most cancers are not hereditary. While some cancers have a genetic component, the majority are caused by a combination of genetic, environmental, and lifestyle factors.

What are the risk factors for developing cancer?

Risk factors for cancer vary depending on the type of cancer but may include smoking, excessive alcohol consumption, obesity, family history of cancer, and exposure to certain chemicals or radiation.

How is cancer diagnosed?

Cancer is diagnosed through various methods, including imaging tests (e.g., X-rays, CT scans), biopsies (tissue samples), blood tests, and other diagnostic procedures.

Is cancer treatment painful?

Cancer treatment can cause side effects, and some treatments, such as surgery and radiation therapy, may cause temporary discomfort. However, medical professionals aim to manage pain and side effects effectively.

Can cancer be cured?

The potential for cure depends on the type and stage of cancer. Some cancers are curable, while others can be managed effectively, allowing patients to live with the disease as a chronic condition.

Can cancer treatment affect fertility?

Some cancer treatments, such as chemotherapy and radiation therapy, can affect fertility. It's essential to discuss fertility preservation options with the oncologist before starting treatment.

What is the role of palliative care in cancer treatment?

Palliative care focuses on improving the quality of life for patients with advanced cancer, managing symptoms, providing emotional support, and addressing end-of-life care.

When should I see an endocrinologist?

You should consider seeing an endocrinologist if you have symptoms or a diagnosis of a hormone-related disorder, or if you are not responding well to initial treatments.

How is diabetes diagnosed and managed?

Diabetes is diagnosed through blood tests measuring glucose levels. Management includes blood sugar monitoring, lifestyle changes, medication, and insulin therapy as needed.

What is the role of hormones in the body?

Hormones are chemical messengers produced by glands that regulate various bodily functions, including metabolism, growth, reproduction, and mood.

Is hormonal imbalance the same as an endocrine disorder?

Hormonal imbalance can be a symptom of an endocrine disorder, but not all hormonal imbalances indicate a specific disorder.

Can hormone disorders cause weight gain or loss?

Yes, certain hormone disorders can lead to weight changes. For example, hypothyroidism may cause weight gain, while hyperthyroidism may lead to weight loss.

Are endocrine disorders treatable?

Many endocrine disorders are treatable or manageable with appropriate medical intervention and lifestyle modifications.

Can stress affect hormone levels?

Yes, chronic stress can impact hormone levels and may contribute to certain endocrine disorders.

Infertility

Sri Lakshmi Speciality Hospital: Your Premier Destination for Comprehensive Infertility Care

With over 30 years of excellence in healthcare, Sri Lakshmi Speciality Hospital stands out as the leading provider of infertility services in KR Puram, Bangalore. Our team of experienced fertility specialists and healthcare professionals is committed to offering personalized, patient-centric care using state-of-the-art technology and advanced treatment methods. Explore our wide range of infertility services and modern facilities designed to support your journey towards parenthood.

Aboout us
Expert Doctors

At Sri Lakshmi Hospital, expert doctors offer top-notch care with skill and compassion.

24/7 Support

Sri Lakshmi Hospital provides round-the-clock support for uninterrupted care and assistance.

Infertility Services:

 Comprehensive Care for Your Fertility Journey

At Sri Lakshmi Speciality Hospital, we offer a full spectrum of infertility services to diagnose, treat, and manage fertility issues in both men and women. Our expert fertility specialists provide personalized care tailored to each patient’s unique needs. Our services include:

Key Gynecological Services:
Diagnostic Services:

Comprehensive fertility evaluations including hormonal tests, semen analysis, and imaging studies to identify the underlying causes of infertility.

Ovulation Induction:

 Medications and monitoring to stimulate ovulation and enhance the chances of conception.

Intrauterine Insemination (IUI):

A minimally invasive procedure that places sperm directly into the uterus to increase the likelihood of fertilization.

In Vitro Fertilization (IVF):

Advanced assisted reproductive technology involving the retrieval of eggs, fertilization in the laboratory, and embryo transfer to the uterus.

Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection (ICSI):

A specialized form of IVF where a single sperm is injected directly into an egg to facilitate fertilization.

Donor Programs:

Egg, sperm, and embryo donation programs to assist individuals and couples facing specific fertility challenges.

Contraceptive Counseling:

Guidance on the best contraceptive options for your lifestyle and needs.

Advanced Fertility Treatments:

Innovative Solutions for Better Outcomes

Our infertility department utilizes a variety of advanced treatments and techniques to ensure the best possible outcomes for our patients. Our innovative solutions include:

Key Obstetrics Services:
Preimplantation Genetic Testing (PGT):

Screening embryos for genetic abnormalities to enhance the chances of a healthy pregnancy.

Fertility Preservation:

Options such as egg, sperm, and embryo freezing for individuals and couples wishing to delay parenthood.

Laparoscopic and Hysteroscopic Surgery:

Minimally invasive surgeries to correct structural issues affecting fertility, such as fibroids, polyps, and endometriosis.

Sri Lakshmi Speciality Hospital features specialized infertility clinics that offer targeted treatments and expert care for specific fertility issues. These clinics ensure that patients receive the most appropriate and effective therapies. Our specialized infertility clinics include:

Discover more

Key Facilities Include:

  • Male Infertility Clinic: Comprehensive care for male fertility issues including hormonal imbalances, varicocele, and azoospermia.
  • Female Infertility Clinic: Focused treatment for female fertility challenges such as PCOS, endometriosis, and unexplained infertility.
  • Recurrent Pregnancy Loss Clinic: Specialized care for couples experiencing recurrent miscarriages, with advanced diagnostics and treatments to support successful pregnancies.
  • Recurrent Pregnancy Loss Clinic: Specialized care for couples experiencing recurrent miscarriages, with advanced diagnostics and treatments to support successful pregnancies.

How can we help you?
When should I seek help for infertility?

If you have been actively trying to conceive for a year without success (or six months if the woman is over 35), it's advisable to consult a fertility specialist.

Can stress cause infertility?

While stress can affect overall health, there is no definitive evidence that stress alone directly causes infertility. However, managing stress during the fertility journey is essential.

Is infertility only a female problem?

Infertility can result from male, female, or combined factors. Approximately one-third of infertility cases are attributed to female factors, one-third to male factors, and one-third to combined or unexplained causes.

Does age affect fertility?

Yes, female fertility declines with age, primarily due to a decrease in the number and quality of eggs. Male fertility may also be affected by age, although to a lesser extent.

Is fertility treatment always successful?

Success rates for fertility treatments vary depending on factors such as the underlying cause of infertility, the age of the individuals involved, and the specific treatment being used.

Are fertility treatments safe?

Fertility treatments are generally safe, but like any medical procedure, they carry some risks. It's essential to discuss potential risks and benefits with a fertility specialist.

Can lifestyle changes improve fertility?

Adopting a healthy lifestyle, including maintaining a balanced diet, regular exercise, managing stress, and avoiding smoking and excessive alcohol consumption, can positively impact fertility in some cases.

At Sri Lakshmi Speciality Hospital, we offer a full spectrum of gastroenterology services to diagnose, treat, and manage a variety of digestive health conditions. Our expert gastroenterologists provide personalized care tailored to each patient’s unique needs. Our services include:

Comprehensive care for common digestive disorders such as acid reflux, gastritis, and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS).

Advanced diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopy procedures including upper endoscopy, colonoscopy, and ERCP.

Specialized care for liver diseases such as hepatitis, fatty liver disease, and cirrhosis.

Accurate diagnosis is crucial for effective treatment. Our gastroenterology department is equipped with the latest diagnostic tools and technology to provide precise and timely identification of digestive conditions. Our advanced diagnostic services include:

Detailed examination of the colon and rectum to detect polyps, cancer, and other conditions.

Colonoscopy:

Detailed examination of the colon and rectum to detect polyps, cancer, and other conditions.

Endoscopic Ultrasound (EUS):

Combining endoscopy and ultrasound to provide detailed images of the digestive tract and surrounding tissues.

You should see a gastroenterologist if you experience persistent digestive symptoms, abdominal pain, changes in bowel habits, or have a family history of GI disorders.

What can I do to prevent GERD and heartburn?

To reduce GERD symptoms, avoid trigger foods, eat smaller meals, avoid lying down after eating, and maintain a healthy weight.

Is colonoscopy painful?

Colonoscopy is typically performed under sedation, so most patients do not feel pain during the procedure.

Can liver cirrhosis be reversed?

Early-stage liver cirrhosis may be reversible if the underlying cause is treated. However, advanced cirrhosis is generally irreversible, and management focuses on preventing further damage and complications.

What is gluten, and why is it harmful in celiac disease?

Gluten is a protein found in wheat, barley, and rye. In celiac disease, gluten triggers an autoimmune response that damages the small intestine lining, leading to malabsorption and other symptoms.

Are there dietary restrictions for IBD or IBS?

Dietary restrictions may vary depending on the individual and the specific condition. A gastroenterologist or registered dietitian can provide personalized dietary advice

Aboout us

24/7 Support

Dialysis Services:

Comprehensive Care for Kidney Health

At Sri Lakshmi Speciality Hospital, we offer a full spectrum of dialysis services to support patients with kidney disease and ensure their overall well-being. Our expert nephrologists provide personalized care tailored to each patient’s unique needs. Our services include:

Key Gynecological Services:
Hemodialysis:

Effective removal of waste and excess fluid from the blood using advanced dialysis machines.

Peritoneal Dialysis:

A home-based treatment that uses the peritoneum in the abdomen as a membrane to filter blood.

Continuous Ambulatory Peritoneal Dialysis (CAPD):

A form of peritoneal dialysis that allows patients to perform exchanges manually throughout the day.

Automated Peritoneal Dialysis (APD):

A nighttime peritoneal dialysis treatment performed by a machine while the patient sleeps.

Comprehensive Obstetrics Car

Our dialysis department is equipped with the latest technology to provide the most effective and comfortable treatments. Key features of our advanced dialysis technology include:

Key Obstetrics Services:

How can we help you?
When is dialysis necessary?

Dialysis is necessary when the kidneys lose their ability to adequately filter waste and fluids from the blood, resulting in a dangerous buildup of toxins in the body.

Is dialysis permanent?

For individuals with ESRD, dialysis is a lifelong treatment unless they receive a kidney transplant.

How long does a dialysis session last?

Hemodialysis sessions typically last around 3 to 4 hours and are usually required three times a week. Peritoneal dialysis involves daily exchanges of dialysis fluid.

Can I travel while on dialysis?

Yes, dialysis patients can travel, but it requires some planning and coordination with healthcare providers to ensure access to dialysis facilities at the travel destination.

Can I eat or drink during dialysis?

During hemodialysis, patients may be restricted from eating or drinking due to the potential risk of fluid overload. Peritoneal dialysis allows for more flexibility in diet and fluid intake.

Are there any side effects of dialysis?

Dialysis can cause side effects like low blood pressure, muscle cramps, nausea, and fatigue. However, these can often be managed with proper medical care.

Can a kidney transplant eliminate the need for dialysis?

Yes, a successful kidney transplant can restore kidney function, eliminating the need for dialysis.

Does dialysis cure kidney disease?

Dialysis does not cure kidney disease but serves as a life-sustaining treatment by performing the function of the kidneys when they are no longer able to do so.

Do I need a doctor's referral to see a physiotherapist?

In many countries, you can directly access physiotherapy services without a doctor's referral. However, insurance policies and regulations may vary.

How long does a physiotherapy session typically last?

Physiotherapy sessions usually last between 30 minutes to an hour, depending on the treatment plan and the patient's needs.

Will physiotherapy be painful?

Physiotherapy aims to alleviate pain and promote healing. While some techniques may cause mild discomfort during treatment, it should not be excessively painful.

How many physiotherapy sessions will I need?

The number of sessions required depends on the individual's condition, severity of the problem, and response to treatment. The physiotherapist will determine the appropriate treatment plan.

Can physiotherapy prevent surgery?

In some cases, physiotherapy can help manage and improve certain conditions, potentially reducing the need for surgery. However, it varies depending on the specific situation.

Is physiotherapy only for adults?

Physiotherapy is beneficial for people of all ages, including infants, children, and older adults.

What should I wear to a physiotherapy session?

Wear comfortable, loose-fitting clothing that allows easy access to the affected area for assessment and treatment.

How can we help you?
What is the difference between a psychologist and a psychiatrist?

Psychologists are trained in psychology and hold doctoral degrees (Ph.D. or Psy.D.), focusing on therapy and assessments. Psychiatrists are medical doctors (M.D. or D.O.) specializing in psychiatry, prescribing medication and offering therapy.

When should I consider seeking help from a psychologist?

You may consider seeking help from a psychologist if you are experiencing emotional distress, struggling with relationships, facing life transitions, or dealing with mental health concerns.

How long does therapy typically last?

The duration of therapy varies depending on individual needs and goals. It can range from short-term (a few weeks) to long-term (several months or more).

Is therapy confidential?

Yes, therapy is generally confidential, and therapists are bound by professional ethics to maintain client privacy. There are exceptions in cases where there is a risk of harm to self or others.

Can therapy be helpful for children and adolescents?

Yes, therapy can be beneficial for children and adolescents dealing with various emotional and behavioral issues.

Can mental health disorders be cured?

Some mental health disorders can be effectively managed and treated, leading to symptom remission and improved quality of life.

What should I do if I suspect a friend or family member has a mental health issue?

Encourage them to seek professional help from a psychologist or psychiatrist. Offer support and be understanding about their experience.

How can we help you?
Is radiation used in all imaging techniques?

Not all imaging techniques use radiation. X-rays, CT scans, and fluoroscopy involve ionizing radiation, whereas MRI and ultrasound do not use ionizing radiation.

Is radiation from X-rays and CT scans dangerous?

While X-rays and CT scans involve low doses of radiation, repeated exposure may carry some risks. However, radiologists carefully consider the benefits of the procedure versus the potential risks.

Can pregnant women undergo radiological exams?

Pregnant women should inform their healthcare provider and radiologist about their pregnancy to determine the necessity and safety of any radiological exam. Some imaging procedures may be avoided or postponed during pregnancy.

How long does it take to get imaging results?

The time to receive imaging results can vary depending on the facility and urgency of the case. In emergencies, results may be available immediately, while in non-urgent cases, it may take a few days.

Is contrast dye used in all imaging studies?

Contrast dye is not used in all imaging studies. It is often used in CT scans, MRI, and some angiograms to enhance the visibility of certain structures or blood vessels.

Do radiologists perform surgeries or provide treatment?

Radiologists are primarily involved in diagnosing diseases through medical imaging. However, interventional radiologists may perform minimally invasive procedures to treat certain conditions.

Are radiologists and radiologic technologists the same?

No, radiologists are medical doctors who specialize in interpreting medical images, while radiologic technologists are skilled professionals who perform the imaging procedures but do not interpret the images.

How can we help you?
When should I see a dermatologist?

You should see a dermatologist if you have concerning skin symptoms, persistent rashes, or any changes in moles or growths.

Can skin cancer be cured?

Early detection and treatment of skin cancer increase the chances of a cure. Certain types, like basal cell carcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma, have a high cure rate when caught early.

Are there ways to prevent acne?

Practicing good skincare, avoiding pore-clogging products, and managing stress can help prevent acne breakouts.

What can I do to protect my skin from the sun?

Sun protection measures include wearing sunscreen, seeking shade, and wearing protective clothing, especially during peak sun hours.

Can I remove moles at home?

It's not recommended to remove moles at home as it may lead to infection, scarring, or incomplete removal. Always have moles evaluated by a dermatologist.

How do I know if a skincare product is suitable for my skin?

Patch testing and consulting with a dermatologist can help determine the suitability of skincare products for your skin type.

Is laser hair removal permanent?

Laser hair removal can significantly reduce hair growth, but it may not permanently eliminate all hair.

Can stress affect the skin?

Yes, stress can worsen certain skin conditions like eczema, acne, and hives.

With over 30 years of excellence in healthcare, Sri Lakshmi Speciality Hospital is your trusted partner for expert ENT (Ear, Nose, and Throat) care in KR Puram, Bangalore. At Sri Lakshmi Speciality Hospital, we offer a full spectrum of ENT services to diagnose, treat, and manage a variety of ear, nose, and throat conditions. Our expert ENT specialists provide personalized care tailored to each patient’s unique needs. Our services include:

Accurate diagnosis is crucial for effective treatment. Our ENT department is equipped with the latest diagnostic tools and technology to provide precise and timely identification of ENT conditions. Our advanced diagnostic services include:

How can we help you?
When should I see an ENT specialist?

You should see an ENT specialist if you experience persistent ear pain, hearing loss, chronic sinus problems, voice changes, or swallowing difficulties.

Can allergies cause ear problems?

Yes, allergies can lead to ear problems, such as Eustachian tube dysfunction, which may cause ear pressure and hearing difficulties.

Is tonsillitis contagious?

Yes, tonsillitis caused by a viral or bacterial infection can be contagious and spread through respiratory droplets.

What causes vertigo?

Vertigo can be caused by inner ear disorders like benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV) or Meniere's disease, among others.

Can sinusitis be chronic?

Yes, sinusitis can become chronic if symptoms persist for more than 12 weeks despite appropriate medical treatment.

Is hearing loss permanent?

Hearing loss can be permanent in some cases, especially if it is due to age-related factors or certain types of inner ear damage.

What can I do to prevent ear infections?

To reduce the risk of ear infections, avoid inserting foreign objects into the ear canal and keep the ears dry after swimming or bathing.

How can we help you?
What are the common symptoms of respiratory diseases?

Common symptoms include cough, shortness of breath, chest pain, wheezing, and coughing up blood.

Is COPD reversible?

While COPD is not reversible, early diagnosis and appropriate management can slow down its progression and improve quality of life.

Can lung cancer be prevented?

Although not all lung cancers can be prevented, avoiding tobacco smoke and reducing exposure to environmental toxins can significantly lower the risk.

Are there vaccines to prevent respiratory infections?

Yes, vaccines are available for certain respiratory infections like influenza and pneumonia. It's essential to get vaccinated, especially for individuals at higher risk.

How can I keep my lungs healthy?

Regular exercise, avoiding smoking and second-hand smoke, maintaining good indoor air quality, and getting vaccinated can help keep your lungs healthy.

What are the early warning signs of asthma worsening?

Early warning signs include increased use of rescue inhalers, frequent coughing at night, and decreased lung function.

Is pulmonary rehabilitation suitable for all respiratory conditions?

Pulmonary rehabilitation can benefit many respiratory conditions, but its suitability is assessed on a case-by-case basis.

Can lung diseases be hereditary?

Yes, certain lung diseases like cystic fibrosis have a genetic basis and can be inherited from parents.

Welcome to Sri Lakshmi Speciality Hospital: Your Trusted Destination for Exceptional Anaesthesiology Care

At Sri Lakshmi Speciality Hospital, we have been at the forefront of delivering excellence in anaesthesiology care for over 30 years. Our commitment to patient-centric care, coupled with our extensive experience, makes us the preferred choice for individuals seeking top-notch medical services in KR Puram, Bangalore. Explore our comprehensive range of services and facilities designed to cater to your unique healthcare needs.

Aboout us
Expert Doctors

At Sri Lakshmi Hospital, expert doctors offer top-notch care with skill and compassion.

24/7 Support

Sri Lakshmi Hospital provides round-the-clock support for uninterrupted care and assistance.

Anaesthesiology Services: Ensuring Comfort and Safety

At Sri Lakshmi Speciality Hospital, our team of skilled anaesthesiologists is dedicated to providing personalized care tailored to each patient’s needs. Whether you require general anaesthesia, regional anaesthesia, or sedation for your procedure, rest assured that you are in capable hands. Our commitment to safety and comfort ensures a smooth experience from pre-operative assessment to post-operative care.

Types of Anaesthesia

We understand that each patient is unique, and their anaesthesia needs may vary. That’s why we offer a variety of anaesthesia options, including:

Types of Anaesthesia
General Anaesthesia:

Induces a state of unconsciousness and total lack of sensation during surgical procedures.

Regional Anaesthesia:

Blocks sensation in a specific part of the body, providing pain relief while allowing patients to remain conscious.

Local Anaesthesia:

Numbs a small area of the body for minor procedures, often used in conjunction with sedation.

Specialities in Anaesthesiology:

Comprehensive Care for Diverse Needs

At Sri Lakshmi Speciality Hospital, we specialize in a wide range of anaesthesiology subfields, including:

Comprehensive Care
Obstetric Anaesthesia:

Providing pain relief during labor and delivery, ensuring a comfortable experience for expectant mothers.

Pediatric Anaesthesia:

 Catering to the unique needs of children undergoing surgery, with a focus on safety and comfort.

Neuroanaesthesia:

Managing anaesthesia for complex neurological procedures, prioritizing patient stability and neurological function.

How can we help you?
What is anaesthesia, and how does it work?

Anaesthesia is a medical technique used to induce a state of controlled unconsciousness or insensitivity to pain during surgical and medical procedures. It can be administered through various methods, including inhalation, injection, or regional nerve blocks. The primary goal of anesthesia is to ensure patient comfort and safety during the procedure.

Is anesthesia safe?

Yes, modern anesthesia techniques are generally safe. Our experienced and certified anesthesiologists follow strict safety protocols and continuously monitor vital signs throughout the procedure. They tailor the anesthesia plan to each patient's unique medical history and needs, minimizing risks and complications.

How do I prepare for anesthesia?

Before your procedure, our team will conduct a thorough preoperative assessment. Follow any fasting or medication instructions provided to you by our medical staff to ensure the effectiveness and safety of anesthesia. Be sure to disclose any allergies, medical conditions, or medications you are currently taking during the preoperative evaluation.

What are the different types of anesthesia?

There are three main types of anesthesia:

  •   General Anesthesia: You will be in a state of complete unconsciousness and feel no pain during the procedure.
  •   Regional Anesthesia: Specific regions of your body will be numbed while you remain conscious or sedated.
  •   Monitored Anesthesia Care (MAC): You will receive sedation and pain relief while remaining conscious during the procedure.
Will I feel pain after the surgery?

Our anesthesiologists work closely with the surgical team to ensure adequate pain management after the procedure. Various pain relief techniques, such as local anesthetics, nerve blocks, and pain medications, will be used to minimize discomfort during the recovery process.

Can children receive anesthesia safely?

Yes, our Anesthesiology Department includes pediatric anesthesia specialists who are highly trained in providing safe and effective anesthesia for children. Their expertise ensures that children receive age-appropriate care and attention during surgical procedures.

What if I have special medical conditions or allergies?

Our team will conduct a comprehensive preoperative assessment to evaluate your medical history and any potential risks related to anesthesia. It is essential to inform us about any allergies, medical conditions, or medications you are currently taking so that we can tailor the anesthesia plan accordingly.

How long does anesthesia take to wear off?

The duration of anesthesia's effects varies depending on the type of anesthesia used and individual factors. Generally, the effects of general anesthesia wear off within a few hours after the procedure, but it may take longer for the effects of regional or local anesthesia to subside.

Neurology Excellence at Sri Lakshmi Specialty Hospital, KR Puram Leading Neurological Care with Precision and Compassion

Centers of Excellence

Neurology

Welcome to Sri Lakshmi Specialty Hospital, a distinguished provider of neurological care in KR Puram, Bangalore. With a legacy of over three decades in healthcare excellence, our hospital is dedicated to delivering comprehensive and compassionate neurology services to patients with neurological disorders. Led by a team of experienced neurologists and supported by state-of-the-art facilities, we strive to ensure optimal neurological health and well-being for all our patients.

Aboout us
Expert Doctors

At Sri Lakshmi Hospital, expert doctors offer top-notch care with skill and compassion.

24/7 Support

Sri Lakshmi Hospital provides round-the-clock support for uninterrupted care and assistance.

Comprehensive Neurology Services

Our Commitment to Neurological Health and Wellness at Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital

At Sri Lakshmi Specialty Hospital, we offer a wide range of neurology services to address the diverse needs of individuals with neurological disorders. Whether you are dealing with a common neurological condition or a complex neurological issue, our team is here to provide expert diagnosis, innovative treatments, and personalized care to help you achieve and maintain optimal neurological health.

Previous slide
Next slide
Key Neurology Services Include:
Neurology Consultations:

Comprehensive evaluations by experienced neurologists to diagnose and manage a variety of neurological conditions, including headache disorders, epilepsy, stroke, movement disorders, and neuropathies.

Diagnostic Testing:

Advanced diagnostic tests, including electroencephalography (EEG), electromyography (EMG), nerve conduction studies (NCS), and neuroimaging (MRI, CT scan), to accurately assess and diagnose neurological conditions.

Stroke Care:

Rapid evaluation and treatment of stroke, including thrombolytic therapy (clot-busting drugs), mechanical thrombectomy, and neurointensive care, to minimize brain damage and improve outcomes.

Epilepsy Management:

 Comprehensive management of epilepsy, including medication therapy, ketogenic diet, vagus nerve stimulation (VNS), and epilepsy surgery, to control seizures and improve quality of life.

Movement Disorders

Specialized care for movement disorders, such as Parkinson’s disease, essential tremor, dystonia, and Huntington’s disease, with a focus on medication management, botulinum toxin injections, and deep brain stimulation (DBS) therapy.

Headache Clinic:

Multidisciplinary evaluation and treatment of headache disorders, including migraines, tension headaches, cluster headaches, and medication-overuse headaches, with a focus on personalized treatment plans and headache management strategies.

Neuromuscular Disorders:

 Diagnosis and management of neuromuscular disorders, including peripheral neuropathies, myasthenia gravis, muscular dystrophies, and motor neuron diseases, with a focus on symptomatic treatment and rehabilitation.

Memory

Disorders: Comprehensive evaluation and management of memory disorders, including Alzheimer’s disease, mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and other dementias, with a focus on cognitive testing, medication therapy, and supportive care.

Specialized Neurological Care

Expertise Across a Range of Neurological Conditions at Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital

Sri Lakshmi Specialty Hospital is home to a team of highly skilled neurologists with expertise in diagnosing and treating a wide range of neurological conditions. Whether you are dealing with a common neurological disorder or a rare neurological disease, our specialists are here to provide expert care and personalized treatment options to meet your unique needs

Key Neurological Specialties Include:
Stroke Neurology:

Specialized care for patients with acute ischemic stroke, hemorrhagic stroke, and transient ischemic attack (TIA), with a focus on rapid diagnosis, thrombolytic therapy, mechanical thrombectomy, and stroke prevention strategies.

Epilepsy Neurology:

Expert management of epilepsy and seizure disorders, including diagnostic evaluation, medication management, ketogenic diet therapy, epilepsy surgery, and neuromodulation techniques, to control seizures and improve quality of life.

Movement Disorders Neurology:

Comprehensive care for patients with movement disorders, including Parkinson’s disease, essential tremor, dystonia, chorea, and ataxia, with a focus on medication management, botulinum toxin injections, and deep brain stimulation (DBS) therapy.

Headache Neurology:

Multidisciplinary evaluation and treatment of headache disorders, including migraines, tension headaches, cluster headaches, and medication-overuse headaches, with a focus on personalized treatment plans and headache management strategies.

Diagnosis and management of neuromuscular disorders, including peripheral neuropathies, myasthenia gravis, muscular dystrophies, motor neuron diseases, and myopathies, with a focus on symptomatic treatment and rehabilitation.

Memory Disorders Neurology:

Comprehensive evaluation and management of memory disorders, including Alzheimer’s disease, mild cognitive impairment (MCI), vascular dementia, and frontotemporal dementia, with a focus on cognitive testing,

Specialized Neurological Care

Expertise Across a Range of Neurological Conditions at Sri Lakshmi Super Speciality Hospital

Sri Lakshmi Specialty Hospital is home to a team of highly skilled neurologists with expertise in diagnosing and treating a wide range of neurological conditions. Whether you are dealing with a common neurological disorder or a rare neurological disease, our specialists are here to provide expert care and personalized treatment options to meet your unique needs

Thrombolytic Therapy:

Intravenous administration of clot-busting drugs, such as tissue plasminogen activator (tPA), for the treatment of acute ischemic stroke, when administered within the appropriate time window, to restore blood flow to the brain and minimize disability.

Mechanical Thrombectomy:

Minimally invasive procedure for the removal of blood clots from the cerebral arteries using specialized devices, such as stent retrievers and aspiration catheters, for the treatment of large vessel occlusions in acute ischemic stroke.

Epilepsy Surgery:

Surgical interventions, such as focal resection, corpus callosotomy, and hemispherectomy, for the treatment of drug-resistant epilepsy, to remove or disconnect the epileptic focus and reduce seizure frequency and severity.

Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS):

Surgical implantation of neurostimulator devices in the brain, with leads targeting specific deep brain structures, such as the subthalamic nucleus (STN) or globus pallidus interna (GPi), for the treatment of movement disorders, such as Parkinson's disease and essential tremor.

Botulinum Toxin Injections

Administration of botulinum toxin (Botox) injections for the treatment of various neurological conditions, including dystonia, spasticity, hemifacial spasm, and chronic migraine, to reduce muscle overactivity and improve symptoms.

Vagus Nerve Stimulation (VNS):

Implantation of a vagus nerve stimulation device in the neck, with leads connected to the vagus nerve, for the treatment of drug-resistant epilepsy and treatment-resistant depression, to modulate neural activity and reduce seizure frequency or improve mood.

Neurorehabilitation Programs:

Comprehensive neurorehabilitation programs, including physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, and cognitive rehabilitation, to promote recovery and maximize functional independence in patients with neurological disabilities.

How can we help you?
What does a neurologist do?

A neurologist is a medical doctor who specializes in diagnosing and treating diseases and disorders of the nervous system. They manage conditions such as epilepsy, stroke, Superple sclerosis, movement disorders, and peripheral nerve disorders.

What are common symptoms of neurological disorders?

Common symptoms of neurological disorders may include headaches, seizures, weakness, numbness, difficulty walking, tremors, memory problems, and changes in speech or vision.

What causes neurological disorders?

Neurological disorders can have various causes, including genetics, infections, immune system disorders, trauma, tumors, and degenerative conditions.

When should I see a neurologist?

You should consider seeing a neurologist if you experience persistent or concerning neurological symptoms, such as unexplained headaches, seizures, weakness, balance problems, or changes in cognition.

Can neurological conditions be cured?

The outcome and treatment options depend on the specific neurological condition. While some conditions can be managed effectively and symptoms improved, others may require ongoing treatment and symptom management.

What is a stroke, and how is it treated?

A stroke occurs when blood flow to the brain is interrupted, leading to brain cell damage. Treatment for stroke includes time-sensitive interventions such as clot-dissolving medications (thrombolytics) and, in some cases, mechanical thrombectomy to remove the clot.

Can neurology treatment be combined with other medical specialties?

Yes, neurology often collaborates with other medical specialties, such as neurosurgery, physical medicine and rehabilitation, and psychiatry, to provide comprehensive care for patients with complex neurological conditions.

Are there ways to prevent neurological disorders?

While not all neurological disorders can be prevented, adopting a healthy lifestyle, managing chronic conditions (e.g., diabetes, hypertension), wearing helmets during activities with head injury risks, and avoiding toxins or infections that can affect the nervous system may reduce the risk of some conditions.

Leading Nephrology Care with Compassion and Expertise

Welcome to Sri Lakshmi Specialty Hospital, a distinguished provider of nephrology care in KR Puram, Bangalore. With over three decades of commitment to healthcare excellence, our hospital is dedicated to delivering comprehensive and compassionate nephrology services to patients with kidney-related conditions. Led by a team of experienced nephrologists and supported by state-of-the-art facilities, we strive to ensure optimal kidney health and well-being for all our patients.

Expert Doctors

At Sri Lakshmi Hospital, expert doctors offer top-notch care with skill and compassion.

24/7 Support
